match.zip: Dragon Ball Z - Collectible Card Game.zip

widgets.label: How a turn works
rows: Reach the highest power level or beat the opponent's anger/survival conditions
Attacker plays physical or energy attacks, defender blocks with matching cards
Your life bar: attacks lower them, at zero you lose life cards
Fills with certain cards; at max your personality levels up

widgets.text: Keep blocks for both physical and energy attacks in hand; energy attacks cost power stages, so don't empty yourself before blocking.
widgets.title: Tip

widgets.text: Three battles per tier; winning a tier unlocks the next and new personalities.
Win battles to earn booster packs; edit decks in the deck menu. Keep decks lean: duplicates of strong blocks beat many weak attacks.
